**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4223. **Held at draft deliberately**: its CI red is main's rc.6 fallout (proven three independent ways below), so the seat flips ready + queues it once the train-finisher lands the fix set and main is green again — pushing it into the queue now would only bounce.

The delivery itself is the ruling implemented precisely. Consumer map measured: exactly two global-feed readers, both in app-shell (the bell + `useHomeInbox`), every other approvals/activity reader record- or page-scoped and untouched — so sharing needed no new dependency edge and the needs_decision escape was correctly not taken. The shape — a module-scoped store with `useSyncExternalStore`, one in-flight request, one 30s poll, one 404-retirement rule — makes the badge and the Home card structurally incapable of disagreeing, which was the acceptance criterion. The presence boundary produced the report's best measurement: presence was never a READ (the misleadingly-named `fetchPresenceAndActivities` only ever fetched sys_activity; presence is a transport subscription), so the app-gate is a RENDER gate and stays — the dividing line is data scope, not surface. Two test-direction deviations reported as measured rather than forced (the read-count pin passes on main because the bell never fetched — it guards future naive un-gating; the presence control re-anchored off a read the home variant doesn't issue). The rc.6-fallout attribution earned its confidence: same failures on main at both `38ab5054f` and `a9a67ec5b`, byte-identical failure set on the reverted tree, unchanged by merging current main — and the three unenumerated red surfaces were COMMENTED ONTO #4167 with receipts instead of filed as twins, which is exactly right and directly fed the train-finisher dispatch now running. #4225 (Home's duplicate inbox read, observation-class with a real shape difference argument) stays a finding.
